neighbours.label: 'most of' as an emphatic start: ' of' and ' all' in 'but most of all'
fire: But most of all, he wanted a quiet home.
And most of all, we thank the volunteers.
Yet most of all, they feared the winter.
But perhaps most of all, the bread was fresh.
Most of all, keep your receipt.
But most of all, I remember her laugh.
And perhaps most of all, the view was fine.
Yet most of all, it was cheap.
quiet: But some of us wanted a quiet home.
And many of us thank the volunteers.
Yet none of them feared the winter.
But perhaps two of the loaves were fresh.
One of them kept the receipt.
But few of us remember her laugh.
And perhaps part of the view was fine.
Yet half of it was cheap.

notes: Second round; the first ('most of all', 'surtout') failed because ' of' after 'most' fired in near misses that shared the prefix. Here the near misses use other quantifiers before ' of', so the prefix differs. ' surtout' was weak and is left out. No new probes.
